correctness.rationale: Proof reconstructed: every KG(6,2) vertex is a 2-subset of six points and has six disjoint neighbors; ordinary forcing succeeds under monotone closure independent of move order. An independent exhaustive enumeration of all 5005 nine-black sets found no successes, and all 3003 ten-black sets found 1662 successes. Independent S6 enumeration partitioned successes into 7 orbits of sizes 360,360,360,360,90,72,60. Token-jump adjacency over the 1662 states has 24270 edges and degree frequencies 26:450,29:360,30:432,32:420; independent all-source BFS found eccentricity 5 for every state and unordered distances (24270,202320,557820,477855,118026). This is an exhaustive finite proof only for KG(6,2).
